environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed with origin access restricted through CloudFront distribution (distribution ID E2X9K4LMNO). The Lambda function URL has AuthType AWS_IAM and is configured as a CloudFront origin with Origin Access Control (OAC) policy cf-oac-wf-prod-7a2e. CloudFront behaviors require signed URLs using key group kg-prod-wf-2024 (RSA 2048-bit, key ID K3M8NP2QRS) with a 300-second TTL policy. The CloudFront distribution has a custom origin request policy (pol-req-wf-8b3f) that strips and re-signs the request body hash. Direct Lambda URL invocation returns 403 due to IAM auth requirement - only the CloudFront OAC service principal has sts:AssumeRole for the Lambda invoke role. API Gateway endpoint is not deployed in this environment; all traffic routes through CloudFront signed URL path exclusively.

config.direct_access: blocked by IAM AuthType on function URL
